en: Theragāthā 2.12 Dukanipāta, Second Chapter I am one who has reached the goal, one who has done what was to be done; I have laid down the burden and am liberated through the destruction of craving. I have attained the supreme peace, the cool state, And I dwell, having reached the further shore of existence.
The Verses of the Elder Jotidāsa: “Those who, indeed,
by means of various actions mixed with hypocrisy...”
People obstruct others, acting with harshness;
yet they themselves are treated in that very same way.
For indeed, karma does not perish:
whether it be wholesome or unwholesome.
"He is the heir to each and every deed that he performs. ...
